messages:
Sasha: heads-up — nightly eval flagged newmodel-v2-quant8 on legal-snippets. factuality FPR jumped from ~1.1% to 9.7% overnight. eval-bot attached run summary. :warning:

Omar: wait, who opted into quant8 for bringup? I thought we were keeping newmodel on int4 until longcontext fixes landed.

Meera: I kicked a quick quant8 smoke last night because int4 was timing out on some 8k+ cases. Didn’t expect this scale.

eval-bot: ```
RUN: nightly-eval/2024-11-05-23:40
MODEL: newmodel-v2-quant8
COHORT: legal-snippets
METRIC: factuality_fpr
BASELINE: 0.011 -> CURRENT: 0.097 (+777%)
SAMPLES: 1250
COMMON_FAIL_TYPES: truncation, hallucinated-clause, citation-mismatch
```

Anya: initial severity? Are there any dedicated customers running this model yet? If yes, mark P1. @Sasha

Sasha: assigning owners — Meera (onboard) and Omar (quant infra). Mark as P2 for now (no prod traffic mapped). We need fast RCA. :eyes:

Jacob: quick triage checklist: 1) reproduce int4 vs quant8 on same RNG seed, 2) inspect tokenizer splits/offsets for long legal prompts, 3) dump kvcache/padding traces to check alignment. I'll run (1) now.

Meera: running compare job: `./eval/compare --cohort legal-snippets --models newmodel-v2-int4,newmodel-v2-quant8 --seed 1337 --topk 1` — will post diffs when done.

Omar: grabbing per-token logs for top failing examples: `curl -s "https://s3.internal/runs/2024-11-05/newmodel-quant8/badcases.jsonl" | jq .` — looking for hallucination bursts at token ~10-50.

eval-bot: posted 3 sample traces showing spurious clause insertion starting token 18. tags: [hallucination,long-prefix].

Meera: compare results: int4 FPR = 0.013 (close to baseline). quant8 reproduces 0.096. Diff CSV attached to job. Most diffs are invented statute references and extra quoted citations; truncation not the dominant mode.

Omar: infra note — there was a kernel-selection hotfix deployed 23:24 UTC that toggles fused-attn fallback for long sequences. I suspect quant kernels took a different path. Rolling back locally to validate.

Anya: propose immediate actions: 1) pause quant8 nightly for newmodel, 2) rollback kernel-selector hotfix in staging, 3) audit quant tables/scale factors for quant8 build, 4) add targeted unit test for legal-snippets cohort. Approve? :+1: or :-1:?

Sasha: +1 to the plan. Meera/Omar own remediation. I'll escalate to eng-runtime if rollback fixes the issue. Tagging @eng-runtime oncall to watch the rollback test later.

Jacob: I'll mute the noisy downstream eval alerts for this cohort (keep copies of failing examples). Also snapshot the eval run for manual review.

Meera: saving failing examples and diffs to s3: `s3://redwood-evals/triage/newmodel-v2/2024-11-05/quant8/`. Uploaded diff CSV and seed list. Will open a PR adding the cohort unit test and link to this thread.

Sasha: timeline request — please report back in this thread after rollback test completes. If rollback doesn't fix, escalate to model team for re-quant/retune. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
